title: REQ · Manifest SVG image and spritesheet assets exist under game/public/assets
summary: Nine SVG assets resolve at their manifest paths with manifest dimensions
description: Context: backgrounds/bedroom-room.svg, furniture/{bed,bookshelf,desk}.svg, objects/{old-computer,window,door}.svg, characters/boy-sheet.svg and effects/dust.svg are referenced by manifest.json but missing under game/public/assets. Desired behavior: each exists with width/height equal to the manifest dimensions. Why: pixel-art friendly assets must not be stretched.
acceptance_criteria: Given the manifest, When each of the nine SVG paths is resolved under game/public/assets, Then a file exists
Given each SVG, When its root width and height attributes are read, Then they equal the manifest dimensions
Given each SVG, When parsed, Then it starts with an svg root element using crispEdges rendering
